messages.subject: Importing files from an SVN
parts:
I am trying to import files to my app by using download.file on the pseudo url http://username:pass...@hostname.net/csvfile.csv 

Is it that url scheme that doesn't work in shinyApps? Because it works for me locally. Is there a working substitute?

messages.author: 339e79cc1e1fe473
messages.subject: Re: Importing files from an SVN
parts:
Thanks for the reply. I managed to fix it using RCurl package.

I guess calling download.file or read.csv to that type of url won't work unless its inside the R console? 
I was getting the same errors when I ran my app through windows CMD either.
I also tried using method="curl" when using download.file but I still got the same error.

Here is what I did to make it work:
    lines <- getURL(CSVlocation, userpwd = paste0(username, ":", password))
    data <- read.csv(text = lines)

parts:
Yes, and it returns both a warning and an error.
The warning is warning in download.file(...): unable to resolve 'robert' (which is what my username is). 
The error is also in download.file:  cannot open URL "<the url i use for csvs>".
So it works in the interactive console, not in the CMD or in shiny server.
I can only suppose that the second colon seperating the username/password in the url is read differently in CMD. I've tried to use escape characters in front, but it doesn't help.

I also confirmed that normal urls worked fine in CMD with this URL http://gs.statcounter.com/files/Windows-8-stats.csv
